serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Liferay SaaS is a fully managed digital experience platform
(DXP) for building and operating public websites,
constituent, customer and partner portals, employee
intranets, and self-service applications on a single platform.
Liferay hosts, monitors, patches, and upgrades the service;
customers configure and extend it without managing
infrastructure or application servers.
Core capabilities:
- Content and site management: visual page builder with
reusable fragments and templates, multi-site and
multilingual management, and editorial approval workflows
- Documents and media: centralized storage, versioning,
and permission-controlled access to documents and digital
assets
- Low-code applications: custom data models (Liferay
Objects), forms, and configurable workflows for requests,
applications, and approvals
- Identity and access: single sign-on via SAML 2.0 and
OpenID Connect, granular role-based permissions, and user
segmentation
- Search and personalization: enterprise search and
audience-targeted content
- Integration: headless REST and GraphQL APIs, plus client
extensions for custom front ends and integrations without
modifying the core platform
Liferay SaaS runs on Google Cloud Platform (FedRAMP-
certified infrastructure) in U.S. regions and is operated under
Liferay's SOC 2 Type II–audited security program.

alternativeSecurityFramework.impactLevelScope:
Security (Common Criteria), Availability and Confidentiality
— 2017 Trust Services Criteria (TSP section 100); the
examination is a Type 2 SOC 2 plus HIPAA and CSA STAR.
System examined: Liferay Cloud Service Platforms System
of Liferay, Inc., hosted on Google Cloud Platform
(subservice organization, carve-out method). Examination
period: 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31.

documentation.location:
Next examination period: 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31 (A-
LIGN ASSURANCE engagement confirmation letter dated
2026-09-03). Report delivery date to be determined by the
auditor.
